About
Cookies are small text files that can be used by websites to make a user's experience more efficient.

The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary for the operation of this site. For all other types of cookies we need your permission.

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third party services that appear on our pages.

You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

Learn more about who we are, how you can contact us and how we process personal data in our Privacy Policy.

Please state your consent ID and date when you contact us regarding your consent.

You Can’t Predict the Next winning creative

But with the right platform *cough* Sett *cough*, you can create thousands of concepts at scale, making finding the next hit game inevitable.

Games that Fail…

  • have teams waiting weeks and months for new ad creative concepts
  • rely on slow and costly production of creative concepts built purely on opinions: “It’ll work. Just trust me.”
  • are made by creative teams who can’t replace ads in time before the old ones burn from fatigue

Games that win…

  • constantly act on their creative ideas instantly and at scale
  • let testing and performance guide which creatives land and win with users
  • continuously learn from proven concepts and apply that knowledge to create new ideas
